stem.en: Why does a first-time ABO-incompatible transfusion cause an immediate severe reaction, while a first-time Rh(D)-incompatible exposure typically does not?
stem.et: Miks põhjustab esmakordne ABO-sobimatu vereülekanne kohese raske reaktsiooni, samas kui esmakordne Rh(D)-sobimatu kokkupuude tavaliselt seda ei tee?

label.en: Because ABO antibodies are present naturally without prior exposure, while anti-D antibodies only develop after an actual exposure to D-positive blood, so a first Rh-mismatched exposure sensitizes rather than immediately reacts.
label.et: Sest ABO antikehad on loomulikult olemas ilma varasema kokkupuuteta, samas kui anti-D antikehad arenevad välja alles pärast tegelikku kokkupuudet D-positiivse verega, mistõttu esimene Rh-sobimatu kokkupuude tundlikustab, mitte ei reageeri kohe.

label.en: Because ABO blood is less thoroughly screened for compatibility than Rh blood is in standard transfusion protocols.
label.et: Sest ABO verd sõelutakse standardsetes transfusiooniprotokollides sobivuse suhtes vähem põhjalikult kui Rh verd.

label.en: Because people only develop antibodies against antigens they themselves carry, and ABO antigens are more commonly carried than the D antigen.
label.et: Sest inimesed arendavad antikehi ainult nende antigeenide vastu, mida nad ise kannavad, ning ABO antigeenid on levinumad kui D antigeen.

label.en: Because Rh incompatibility is only ever a concern during pregnancy and never applies to blood transfusions between adults.
label.et: Sest Rh-sobimatus on probleemiks ainult raseduse ajal ega kehti kunagi täiskasvanute vaheliste vereülekannete puhul.
